risk_summary: The disclosure identifies meaningful pressure from higher interest rates, weaker mortgage demand, deposit migration, rising costs, and expected compression in net interest margin. It provides useful quantitative detail on funding capacity, capital actions, and sensitivity of the allowance for credit losses, but relies on forward-looking assumptions and extensive accounting-model caveats. Liquidity is presented as adequate for at least 12 months, although the excerpt is incomplete and does not fully quantify downside scenarios.
